architecture_overview: The system is a task management web application designed according to the PO acceptance criteria and SM sprint plan, allowing users to create, update, delete, and track project tasks, assign them to team members, and monitor progress. It uses a microservice architecture with RESTful APIs and separates concerns among frontend, backend, and database layers.

api_endpoints.description: Create a new task with title, description, assignee, and due date.
Retrieve a list of tasks with filtering options such as status or assignee.
Update task details such as status, description, or due date.
Delete a task identified by ID.
Authenticate user and provide JWT token.

database_schema: CREATE TABLE users (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100), email VARCHAR(150) UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT, role VARCHAR(50), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE TABLE tasks (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(200), description TEXT, status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'pending', assignee_id UUID REFERENCES users(id), due_date DATE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP);
security_considerations: Validate and sanitize all input to prevent SQL injection and XSS
Implement RBAC for task modification and access control

implementation_notes: Use Express router modules to organize API endpoints; leverage Sequelize ORM for DB operations; implement React Context for state management; CI/CD pipeline configured with Docker and GitHub Actions; unit tests using Jest and integration tests with Supertest. Apply optimistic UI updates for better UX and use pagination when retrieving task lists.
